title: A multitask learning framework for leveraging subjectivity of annotators to identify misogyny
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical multitask learning framework for misogyny detection, aiming to mitigate bias by modeling the subjectivity of annotators. While it mentions ethical concerns regarding content moderation and who defines misogyny in the introduction, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or moral frameworks as a core component of the research.
